motion_rule: the belt runs him down the hall all clip, the camera swinging round him without stopping, cages and coin towers sweeping across every beat, his face to the lens; his head half the frame; new shot size each beat, one big action per beat, the hero driving it; the tall 9:16 frame filled, no bars
character: a small slow loris with enormous round eyes and heavy rings under them, muzzle always clear of his paws
second_characters: ONE frantic shrew auditor at the lens, big in frame a shoulder away, hurling coin bags and hauling cages across
props: ONE paper tally roll trailing from his paw, longer every beat, only carried, swung or hurled, never worked in place
prop_continuity: the roll grows to 7.85, then he slings it away; the coins never land in it
environment: a coin counting hall at noon, daylight through the glass roof, sorting cages and coin towers a paw away both sides of the belt, no far wall
light_events: hard noon daylight bars his face every beat, cold rim one side, warm kick the other

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: gla-ZA, KRUG-ly-ye, u-div-LE-ni-ya, ne-do-SY-pa, STOL-ko, schi-TAT, NA-do
audio.pacing: 0.40-3.50, 4.20-5.55 and 6.20-7.85 each one breath; after 7.85 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaw drops wide and his lips shape every syllable, brows alive, muzzle clear of paws and props, never a voice over
audio.sfx: belt rumble, coins pouring into cages, the roll ratcheting, a tower going down at 8.50

timeline.a: he rides the belt into frame head first, the roll trailing, coins stacked at his shoulder
he swings round on the moving belt and drives his round eyes into the lens
he shoves a coin tower over past his shoulder as the belt runs him by
he rolls onto his side along the belt and rakes a stack of coins down with him
he drives the roll out at full stretch past the lens as the belt carries him
he takes a coin bag on his chest from the shrew and slings it back past the lens, still riding
he heaves clear and the bag bursts, coins hammering the cages sweeping past
he rolls onto his back along the belt and throws both arms wide at the lens, a coin tower toppling past his shoulder
he ducks a second bag and it bursts on the cages behind
he swings the roll out and it unspools away down the belt behind him
he rakes a shelf of coins onto the belt with one arm as he passes it
he thrusts his face into the lens over the pouring coins, eyes stretched wide
he slings the whole roll ahead down the belt as the shrew hauls a cage across the lens
he drives through the falling paper and shoulders a coin tower down across the lens, one lone coin riding at his hip
he hurls the last paper into the lens and rakes on down the belt, that one coin in his fist

must_appear: one paper tally roll growing every beat; his big eyes with heavy rings; at 8.50 the roll is gone, one lone coin left riding the belt; at 9.20 he hurls the paper into the lens
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, a horizontal 16:9 frame, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a stopped hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, a prop worked in place, a closed muzzle while speaking, a paw over his mouth, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
